title: Birth in Carrollton, New Orleans, and first schooling
summary: Jackson gives his birth date of January 3, 1904, in Carrollton, his mother's address, and early pay school and Tom LeFont School.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Okay, it's going if you want to state your name.
My name is Preston Jackson. I was born in New Orleans, Louisiana, 1904, January the 3rd. I was born in a part of New Orleans called Carrollton.
Remember just the street and the number?

My mother said Cherokee and Ann, but I don't remember the number just now. I attended pay school, what they called pay school then, before ever going to grammar school. And I started in grammar school at Tom LeFont School.
